title: Holly Ross
passages: Holly Ross is a musician from Lancaster, England. She was the guitarist and lead vocalist of the band Angelica from 1994 to 2003. She became the lead performer for The Lovely Eggs from 2006. Her singing has been described as "soft as butter Lancastrian tones."
